title: Test the unit-scalar differentiable-map helper
expectedLearning: Whether the shared unit-scalar map plumbing is stable across affine economics and nonlinear geometry without hiding authored mathematics.
Whether the helper reduces caller boilerplate without materially increasing focused TypeScript inference cost.
allowedWork: Implement one internal experimental unit-scalar differentiable-map helper.
Migrate only the supply-demand and circle pressure callers while preserving their object shapes, IDs, values, derivatives, diagnostics, source identity, and law evidence.
Measure author-line reduction and focused inference delta, then stop for API review.
disallowedWork: Do not add derived-unit algebra, automatic differentiation, basis or equality inference, proof inference, or physical-domain predicates.
Do not promote a public facade, reconcile economics models, add a visible inspector, or migrate any third caller.
